title: Temperature conversion
description:
Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit with whole-number arithmetic.

```
Celsius: 37
Fahrenheit: 98
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
ask:    db      "Celsius: ", 0
said:   db      "Fahrenheit: ", 0

        section .text
_start:
        lea     rdi, [rel ask]
        call    print_str
        call    read_int
        ; TODO: rax = rax * 9 / 5 + 32

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: `imul rax, rax, 9` multiplies by a constant in one instruction (lesson 2.02).
`idiv` divides `rdx:rax` by its operand, so `cqo` copies the sign of `rax` into all of `rdx` first; forgetting it gives a wrong answer or a crash.
stretch: Round to the nearest degree instead of towards zero.
